key_decisions: ROUTE: whole-image relight -> composite only the region back. NOT a localised crop/stitch - EVERY model re-grades the returned patch and leaves a visible rectangle. Do not re-open the model search; Boogu, Klein and Qwen at three tiers were all measured.

The composite-back is a GRAPH TAIL, not an app-side step: ImageBlend(difference) -> ImageToMask -> ThresholdMask -> GrowMaskWithBlur -> ImageCompositeMasked, all core nodes. ONE dispatch, capabilities.multiStage stays FALSE.

Input_Control_strength ships at 0.45-0.60 and the SLIDER IS MANDATORY - Fabio: 'the strength control that we have on the original workflow needs to be the same for this flow'. It is a correctness requirement, not a convenience.

The shadow is NOT a user toggle and the blend pass is ALWAYS ON (Fabio, 2026-08-22). The prompt already makes the shadow conditional on the scene's light, so a toggle re-introduces exactly the unconditional instruction this session removed.
The step copy must say TONAL, not 'structured', for the canny arm - and must warn about a minimum drawing size. Both are Fabio's calls, 2026-08-22.
Medium is a MODEL-SELECTION problem: 'match the scene's art style' does not restyle a photoreal object onto a cel-shaded plate. This makes the any-of picker load-bearing for CORRECTNESS.
constraints: The card's acceptance list still says 'Canny for a clean structured drawing'. That wording is now known to be MISLEADING - canny's niche is a TONAL/shaded drawing, and a user with clean line art who picks canny gets their own ink back as an outline. The docs are healed; the card is not. Heal it at close-out.
ANOTHER SESSION IS LIVE IN THIS TREE: js/data/modelConstants/models.js carries MPI-357 and MPI-25 work and was deliberately NOT committed here. Do not stage it.
Bench is port 8188, app engine is 48188, and :3000 is the USER's app - never drive it. Wrap any bench /prompt call in gpu_lease.py; the guard blocks it otherwise.
qwen_edit.json ships baked at Input_Tier: 3 (Hyper). Tier is a runtime radio, not a model variant - any measurement that does not set it is silently measuring the fastest arm.
Windows Python from the Bash tool: use a .py FILE. Heredocs are blocked by a guard hook, and backticks inside a double-quoted inline script are eaten by the shell.

Do not have two modules each do sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, ...) - the second GCs the first and closes the stream, which surfaces as 'ValueError: I/O operation on closed file' from an unrelated print. Use sys.stdout.reconfigure().
A module imported by a runner must not read sys.argv at import time - contact.py did, and swallowed the runner's own plate argument.
